profile_scope: Hy-MT2 1.8B Q4_K_M experimental v8, one target with source-only context
expected_invariant: A target about handing a document to Doctor Chen must not borrow the payment action from a neighboring ticket-price cue.

minimal_reproducer.neighbor_after: 没有，他把钥匙留在桌上。
minimal_reproducer.context_on_raw_candidate: Заплатил ли Чжан Сяо документ доктору Чен?
minimal_reproducer.context_off_raw_candidate: Раздал ли Чжаньсяо документ врачу Чен?
